# RCHub Plugins

> RCHub is a development plugin platform for PC controls. Plugins are WebAssembly packages with a strict manifest-defined UI and typed, permission-gated capabilities.

## Start here

- [English developer guide](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/docs/plugins/README.md): quick start, package format, permissions, UI controls, examples and compatibility.
- [Türkçe geliştirici rehberi](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/docs/plugins/README.tr.md)
- [Package and protocol contract](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/contracts/plugins/README.md)
- [JSON Schema](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/contracts/plugins/plugin.schema.json)
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/tools/plugins/rchub_plugin.py)
- [Official plugin builder](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/tools/plugins/build_official.py)

## Build a plugin

1. Create a starter manifest and readable Wasm source:
   `python tools/plugins/rchub_plugin.py create examples/my-plugin --id com.example.myplugin --name "My Plugin"`
2. Edit `manifest.json`: declare exact permissions, typed action inputs/outputs and state, and choose controls from the bounded UI schema.
3. Build and validate the package:
   `python tools/plugins/rchub_plugin.py build examples/my-plugin --proxy --out examples/my-plugin/my-plugin.rchub-plugin.json`
   `python tools/plugins/rchub_plugin.py validate examples/my-plugin/my-plugin.rchub-plugin.json`
4. Preview declarative controls in the RCHub development app at `/plugin-preview`. The preview uses local mock state and never sends device commands.
5. Review the source and requested permissions before installing. The host enforces current authorization and the exact saved grant for every operation.

## UI and examples

- Layouts: sections, rows, columns and tabs.
- Controls: buttons, sliders, toggles, selects, inputs, progress indicators, images, typed lists, text, values and status.
- [System example](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/plugins/official/system/manifest.json): bounded host metrics and declarative values.
- [Media & Display example](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/plugins/official/media/manifest.json): grouped volume/mute, brightness and playback controls.
- [Apps example](https://github.com/CetTek/rchub-plugins/blob/main/plugins/official/apps/manifest.json): structured process rows.

## Security and compatibility

- Packages use a strict schema, canonical SHA-256 identity and bounded Core WebAssembly.
- Plugin code has no WASI, arbitrary JavaScript/HTML, filesystem access or package hooks.
- Installation requires explicit review and consent. Later actions still validate identity, current device ownership, capability, grant and typed payload.
- Marketplace and remote execution are development-only. Official packages are MIT reference implementations; native capability availability depends on the host/runtime and platform.
- Read the developer guide and contract for current limits; repository labels and manifest publisher/source text are not cryptographic provenance.
